text: Three videos of planning are done. This is the first lesson where Terraform runs for real against Fairmont Grain's actual Azure subscription.
Bootstrap the state storage account, then terraform init, plan, and apply -- the resource group, VNet, AKS cluster, and Azure SQL server and database, exactly as whiteboarded.
We prove the state lock for real: a second terraform plan started mid-apply is refused outright, with the exact lease holder named in the error.
Every resource gets verified independently with the Azure CLI -- not just a clean terraform apply exit code.
The infrastructure is live and confirmed empty -- no workloads yet. Next: containerizing grain-ingest and deploying it onto this cluster.
